name: Talus Ops
tagline: AI agents, set up and run for you
description: Talus Ops sets up and runs Grok Bot AI agents for small, founder-led US firms in three markets: recruiting and search firms, commercial specialty contractors and independent commercial insurance agencies. We connect the agents to the tools a firm already uses, such as email, calendar, CRM, ATS or AMS and documents, then keep them running with monthly tuning and monitoring. The agents draft and prepare; your people decide. Every engagement starts with a free 20-minute call and a written agent plan. Typical setup takes about 2 weeks (Operator), 3 (Team) or 5 (Department). There are three flat monthly plans, each with a one-time setup fee. Clients pay for their own Grok Bot plan directly. Talus Ops is a DBA of Varosity Inc., San Diego, California.
